links.outcome: Agreement with psychologists on whether to propose or withhold a diagnostic hypothesis
links.effect: PsyCIDRA agreed with psychologists on proposing a hypothesis in 79.6% of cases versus 65.4% for direct prompting.
links.quote: In a blinded study of 101 human participants in separate arms, PsyCIDRA agrees with psychologists on whether to propose a diagnostic hypothesis in 79.6% of cases, compared with 65.4% for direct prompting.

unlisted_practices: Dual-agent design separating interviewing from diagnostic reasoning, with the reasoning agent reporting supporting, conflicting, and missing evidence for expert review
Expert-written skills and working notes to guide AI psychiatric interviewing

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and evaluating a dual-agent LLM framework (PsyCIDRA) for interactive psychiatric interviewing and diagnostic reasoning using simulated profiles and human participants.
